title: chelone glabra subsp. typica
intro: Chelone glabra subsp. typica, commonly known as the white turtlehead, is a perennial plant native to eastern North America, characterized by its white flowers and distinctive turtlehead-shaped inflorescence. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chelone glabra subsp. typica include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
